Rory McIlroy comments on slow play and Masters exemptions

Golfer Rory McIlroy has expressed surprise at the length of rounds at the Irish Open, with some taking up to six hours. He also stated he would advocate for the Irish Open winner to receive a Masters exemption. McIlroy also discussed personal 'bad habits' he intends to change.
